technicalExplanation: Leading technical explanation: deployed commit fe821c5 removed the backend/uploads/* ignore rule while the deployment ran git clean -fd. This exposed untracked uploaded media to cleanup until deployed commit 8f6e7ab restored the rule about eleven minutes later on October 7, 2026. An isolated dry run reproduced that exposure. No retained deletion log proves that this action removed all 86 files; the exact historical cause remains unconfirmed.

incidentDescription: Suspected cause: Inadvertent removal of uploaded media during an automated security-maintenance deployment. A deployed change temporarily removed the Git ignore rule protecting uploaded media, leaving those files subject to deletion by the deployment cleanup command (git clean -fd).
qualification: The cleanup exposure is supported by the deployed revisions and a non-destructive reproduction. Attribution of all 86 missing files to that event, the security-maintenance characterization, and responsibility are not independently confirmed by the retained deletion records. The exact deletion times remain unknown.
